summary: The PR implements the caret matching logic correctly but fails to implement the required prerelease parsing and rejection logic specified in Req 2.
key_findings: matches_caret implementation correctly handles major/minor/patch bounds for major=0 and major>0 cases.
parse_semver_tag function is missing; the ticket requires extending parsing to return (major, minor, patch, pre) and rejecting prereleases unless allow_prerelease=True.
No tests exist for prerelease rejection or the new parse_semver_tag signature.
missing_or_broken: Req 2: parse_semver_tag(tag) returning (major, minor, patch, pre: str | None)
Req 2: Reject prerelease versions in matches_caret unless allow_prerelease=True
